rollups.text: Christina’s triangle-geometry learning progressed from classification and angle relationships on 2024-03-03 to area, medians, altitudes, centroid, coordinate geometry, and GeoGebra on 2024-04-15, then to congruence, similarity, scale factors, and proof methods on 2024-06-10. On March 3 she sought precision for design work and practiced triangle theorems; on April 15 she explored special lines, area methods, and geometric constructions; by June 10 she was applying congruence and similarity to design and construction, studying proof criteria, and using GeoGebra. On June 10 she said she had a good handle on the concepts for now. The sessions span 99 days from March 3 to June 10, 2024.

Christina’s recurring triangle-geometry examples and their recorded dates: 3-4-5 right triangle, 2024-03-03 and 2024-04-15; 5-5-7 isosceles, 2024-03-03; 5-5-8 isosceles, 2024-03-03 and 2024-04-15; 7-9-12 scalene, 2024-03-03; 7-8-10 scalene, 2024-03-03; 8-10-12, 2024-03-03 and 2024-04-15; 8-15-17 right triangle, 2024-03-03 and 2024-04-15; 7-24-25 right triangle, 2024-04-15; 9-12-15, 2024-04-15; 5-6-7, 2024-04-15; 13-14-15, 2024-04-15; 6-8-10 and 9-12-15, 2024-06-10. The examples were used for classification, area, medians and altitudes, congruence, or similarity.

Christina’s stated learning preferences: she prefers visual learning and step-by-step geometric explanations and asks for diagrams when studying triangle classification (2024-03-03); she wants comparisons of multiple methods when asking about triangle-area calculations (2024-04-15); she asks for precise mathematical language, visual aids, and detailed proof outlines with diagrams for triangle-congruence criteria (2024-06-10).

Christina reported several study results and score changes: 10 triangle-classification problems with 8/10 correct on 2024-03-03; 15 classification problems with accuracy consistently above 80% on 2024-03-03; classification and angle-sum homework score of 18/20 on 2024-03-03; triangle-classification quiz score rose from 65% to 82% on 2024-03-03; five Pythagorean-theorem problems with four correct on 2024-03-03; 12 area problems accompanied by an accuracy increase from 70% to 90% on 2024-04-15, reported again on 2024-06-10; special-lines and area-formula quiz score rose from 78% to 88% on 2024-04-15; congruence and similarity test score rose from 80% to 92% on 2024-06-10; practice test score was 18/20 on 2024-06-10; 25 congruence and similarity problems with accuracy exceeding 90% on 2024-06-10. Christina also reported that explaining ASA congruence to her study partner was followed by the partner’s quiz score rising from 60% to 85% on 2024-06-10; this is a reported sequence, not established causation.
